title: Iterated expression for experiment value
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game and let $T$ be a sign tester with a finite seed space. For every long-code table, the value of the long-code experiment equals the average over vertices, chosen uniformly, of the average over tester seeds according to the seed law of the operational check value at that vertex.
hypotheses_covered: A sign tester with finite seed space
